title: gentiana involucrata var. umbellata
intro: Gentiana involucrata var. umbellata, commonly known as the Umbellate Gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the Gentianaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Gentiana involucrata var. umbellata include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, triterpenoids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
